sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Dasylirion acrotrichum is a rosette-forming plant of Mexico's high deserts. Its 30–70 cm leaves form a crown about 1.2–1.5 m across; their margins are spiny and the tips bear fibres.

sections.title: Flowering stalk and plate
sections.text: The flowering stalk rises about 3–4 m, well above the rosette, and bears small flowers followed by fruits. The plate matches the rosette, spiny leaves and tall stalk. No reliable human food use is reported.
